critical_bugs: Silent exception swallowing in all ROS callbacks (except Exception: pass) masks message parsing errors and causes silent data loss without any indication to the operator.
Unbounded list growth for cmd_vel_log, odom_log, joystick_log, etc. will lead to OutOfMemory crashes during extended logging sessions typical in robotics deployments.
warnings: REST API polling uses HTTP instead of HTTPS, transmitting credentials and robot state in cleartext over the network.
CLI-provided session_path is not sanitized or validated, creating a path traversal risk if untrusted input is supplied.
Pickle serialization is used for log storage; it is non-human-readable, version-sensitive, and generally discouraged for data interchange in ML pipelines.
recommendations: Replace bare except blocks with proper logging (e.g., import logging; logger.exception('Callback failed')) to preserve debugging capability without crashing the thread.
Implement a circular buffer or max-entry limit per log list to bound memory usage during long runs.
Sanitize session_path using os.path.abspath() and validate it resides within an expected base directory before writing files.
Migrate REST polling to HTTPS if the MiR100 supports it, or ensure network isolation for cleartext Basic Auth.
Switch persistent storage format to JSON Lines (JSONL) or CSV for better interoperability and VLA training pipeline compatibility.

critical_bugs: ROS client connection not properly closed due to incorrect method call 'terminate' (should be 'close') causing socket resource leak
REST API uses HTTP instead of HTTPS for authentication, transmitting credentials in plaintext
recommendations: Replace 'self.client.terminate()' with 'self.client.close()' in the stop() method to properly close ROS connections
Use HTTPS scheme (https://) for REST API URLs and validate that robot IP supports TLS/SSL
Add configuration option to enforce HTTPS when authentication is provided
